start.speaker: narrator
text: Your first afternoon in Sela. A rented room above a shuttered shop; the sea breeze lifts the curtain.
The last tenant left a wooden board on the desk: a grid of lines, and a bowl of black and white stones.

resolve.speaker: narrator
text: A note under the bowl: 'Ask Pip in the park across the road. He belongs to the club at The Kettle.'
You take the board and stones downstairs.
